notes.title: Version 0.8.5 Live
notes.content:
[h1][b]Special LevelUp Bonus:[/b][/h1][p]Now you will be able to get a new passive in a special bonus selection screen when you reach level 5 and for each 5 levels after that. There are currently 10 passives that can obtained this way and more will be added in the future.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332929/6cc84263c42e21114f5e1dd012d0f1493e9b4fb6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]New Items added![/h1][p]You can now buy the folowing items from the mysterious vending machine, try to obtain them and discover their effects :D[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332929/a6f8ef1e8ab32e165dff5be15298bbf1fa148eb0.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Now with [b]sound[/b]![/h1][p]Sound effect was added to some passive projectiles, objects and when collecting experience drops! I hope to continue improving this in the future![/p][p][/p][h1]More items will appear on the mysterious vending machine![/h1][p]Now you can upgrade the minimum amount of items that will appear on the mysterious vending machine![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332929/52262283ec4a6a5c2a5e90cff29ea0d502f60598.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Minor changes[/h1][list][*][p]Experience bonus now have a low chance of showing on the level up bonus selection;[/p][/*][*][p]Money bonus now have a low chance of showing on the level up bonus selection;[/p][/*][*][p]Projectile bonus now have a low chance of showing on the level up bonus selection;[/p][/*][*][p]Both damage bonus now have a high chance of showing on the level up bonus selection;[/p][/*][*][p]Changes on melee cut animation frames;[/p][/*][*][p]Switched the color of the buttons on the settings menu;[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: Now you will be able to get a new passive in a special bonus selection screen when you reach level 5 and for each 5 levels after that. There are currently 10 passives that can obtained this way and more will be added in the future.
You can now buy the folowing items from the mysterious vending machine, try to obtain them and discover their effects :D
Sound effect was added to some passive projectiles, objects and when collecting experience drops! I hope to continue improving this in the future!
Now you can upgrade the minimum amount of items that will appear on the mysterious vending machine!

tags.balance_change: Experience bonus now have a low chance of showing on the level up bonus selection;
Money bonus now have a low chance of showing on the level up bonus selection;
Projectile bonus now have a low chance of showing on the level up bonus selection;
Both damage bonus now have a high chance of showing on the level up bonus selection;
Changes on melee cut animation frames;

tags.feature: Switched the color of the buttons on the settings menu;

notes.title: Item balancing!

tags.balance_change: Enemies now give less money when defeated;

tags.feature: 2 new common equipments and 1 uncommon weapon were added;

notes.title: Minor and specific bug fixes

tags.bug: [*] Fixed a bug where players could interact with "Play" button without selecting any map, enemy or character;
[*] Now players can´t unequip their weapon when it´s the only one they have;

tags.balance_change: [*] Physical and Elemental attack upgrades initial prices has been increased to 500;
[*] Some weapons had their cost increased;

tags.feature: [*] Now it´s possible to buy (and equip) weapon or equipment directly into a alredy occupied corresponding slot.

notes.title: Bug Fixes, Minor UI changes and Optimization
notes.content:
Improved performance by reducing draw calls.

Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] R0B's gear appearing during pauses (configs and level up menu);
[*] Special effects not disappearing correctly when returning to the main menu;
[*] Upgrade Slot not working properly.
[/list]

UI changes:
[list]
[*] Shop pointer sprite changed;
[*] Inventory now opens when shop does;
[*] Color of the button to return to the main menu modified.
[/list]

Known bugs:
[list]
[*] Resolution change not working correctly;
[*] Fullscreen option always checked.
[/list]
